content:
I'd like to share a Lean 4 formalization of a proof of the Regts–Sevenster conjecture: a complex-valued graph parameter normalized at the empty graph has exponentially bounded edge-connection rank if and only if it is a "mixed partition function" (the partition function of an edge-colouring model on a super vector space ℂ^(k|2ℓ)). The conjecture is proved in an accompanying paper, submitted to arXiv and uploaded in the repo as well. The repository machine-checks both directions, including the paper's dimension bound k, 2ℓ ≤ ⌊2eR⌋.

The forward direction is conditional on exactly one cited input, stated as a hypothesis: Deligne's theorem on tensor categories. The converse is unconditional. There are no sorries, custom axioms or uses of native_decide; every main theorem's axiom set is pinned to [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Lean v4.31.0, Mathlib at the v4.31.0 release tag. CI additionally certifies the six theorems of record with leanprover/comparator, and Challenge.lean is set up for easy auditing.

The paper itself was created with heavy use of Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol Pro, and the formalization was done by Claude Fable 5 and Claude Opus 5.
